narrative.overview: Result names, mathematical summaries, and verification scope provide the structure. A reader can scan the collection and move into a proof without a change in visual language.
dos: Do retain precise status text, contributor credit, and mathematical scope.
Do keep line lengths readable and let narrow layouts reflow.
Do use the existing type and color tokens for additional pages.
donts: Do not add decorative summary metrics, repeated cards, or unnecessary icons.
Do not hide mathematical content behind JavaScript.
Do not shrink mobile text to make a desktop layout fit.
